profile_disposition.planning.profile.first_feasible: supported: RRT and IK return the first valid candidate without deliberate post-solution budget use
profile_disposition.planning.profile.balanced: supported: RRT-star rewiring is enabled while fast return prevents deliberate post-solution budget use
profile_disposition.planning.profile.quality_bounded: supported: RRT-star and IK may spend the configured deterministic planning bound improving the best valid candidate

moveit2.dependency_boundary: ROS and MoveIt types remain private to manyforge_moveit2; manyforge_core and program artifacts use only neutral DTOs and focused ports
moveit2.composition: A MoveIt2 composition factory supplies planner projection, planner, kinematics, reference resolution, and execution-state sink adapters while reusing manyforge_ros2_control_execution for controller transport

IPlannerSceneProjection.mapping: Apply each committed ManyForge SceneTransactionDTO to a derived MoveIt planning_scene::PlanningScene generation, retain immutable generations by exact SceneRevisionBindingDTO lease, and acknowledge only the revision actually projected
required_invariants: no fallback from a missing retained generation to latest scene
attached objects, touch links, world geometry, policy, and canonical frames preserve the transaction revision

IPlannerBackend.joint_goal: Translate canonical joint names and positions to a request-local moveit_msgs MotionPlanRequest/goal constraint and invoke a deployment-selected PlanningPipeline against the retained PlanningScene generation
IPlannerBackend.pose_goal: Translate the canonical base/tcp pose and tolerances to MoveIt goal constraints; IK plus joint planning is valid when observable pose tolerance and error contracts hold
IPlannerBackend.profiles: Deployment configuration maps first_feasible, balanced, and quality_bounded semantics to qualified MoveIt pipeline/plugin configurations; backend plugin names and tuning never enter the program DTO
IPlannerBackend.result: Translate the candidate RobotTrajectory back to canonical TrajectoryDTO names and finite monotonic timing, and stamp the exact retained SceneRevisionDTO
IPlannerBackend.internal_collision: MoveIt collision checks are search-local candidate-generation evidence only; the returned trajectory always passes ManyForge ITrajectoryValidator and ICollisionQueryEngine gates

IRobotKinematics.mapping: Construct MoveIt RobotState from the Robot Model Authority private view, evaluate FK/joint limits in canonical public names, and reject unknown or duplicate name mappings without leaking SRDF/private aliases

IReferencePoseResolver.mapping: Resolve frame, robot-link, object, and inline-pose references from the exact retained projection generation and return neutral Pose3DTO; never read a mutable latest PlanningScene

IExecutionStateSink.mapping: Write selected controller-observed state into the MoveIt derived projection only; controller authority and transport remain in manyforge_ros2_control_execution

planning.motion.joint_goal.implementation_gate: selected PlanningPipeline must return bounded, cancellable, time-parameterized candidates with canonical names

planning.motion.pose_goal.implementation_gate: selected kinematics/planning plugins must satisfy canonical frame mapping and pose tolerances

implementation_options: a qualified MoveIt CartesianInterpolator pipeline with independent full ordered-path fidelity and time-parameterization checks
a qualified Pilz/other plugin that consumes the complete neutral path and preserves bounded cancellation
planning.motion.cartesian_path.rejection: Do not advertise planning.motion.cartesian_path and return unsupported_capability naming that capability; endpoint-only IK is not Cartesian-path support

planning.ik.single_shot.implementation_gate: Use a request-local RobotState setFromIK-style solve with caller timeout and canonical result mapping, or reject planning.ik.single_shot explicitly

planning.cancellation.cooperative.implementation_gate: IPlannerBackend.request_cancel invokes the selected PlanningPipeline/planner-context termination surface without blocking; any plugin that cannot meet the qualified bound is rejected at deployment admission

planning.trajectory.time_parameterized.implementation_gate: translate RobotTrajectory output to finite canonical TrajectoryDTO samples with zero start time, strict monotonic timing, and dimensionally valid positions, velocities, and accelerations

scene.projection.revision_bound.implementation_gate: retained PlanningScene generation and result acknowledgement must match the exact request binding

planning.failure.structured.implementation_gate: MoveIt and plugin error codes map at the adapter boundary to stable ErrorDTO code, reason, failure_stage, and capability details

planning.profile.first_feasible.implementation_gate: select a qualified pipeline/plugin configuration that returns the first valid candidate without deliberate post-solution budget use

planning.profile.balanced.implementation_gate: select a qualified bounded-improvement configuration that returns when its first complete candidate is available

planning.profile.quality_bounded.implementation_gate: select a qualified configuration that spends only the declared deterministic bound and returns the best valid candidate found

adapter_local_gaps.resolution: implement inside manyforge_moveit2 without changing logical scene or collision authority
qualify each selectable planning plugin and reject non-cancellable configurations
select and qualify three deployment-local policy mappings without adding backend fields to programs
implement full path semantics or retain explicit unsupported-capability behavior
consume Robot Model Authority canonical/private fingerprints and prove mimic, gripper, and frame mapping

forbidden_shortcuts: using PlanningSceneMonitor as logical scene authority
dispatching a trajectory because MoveIt reported collision-free
falling forward to the latest scene when a retained revision is missing
embedding planner ids or plugin options in a program artifact
duplicating ros2_control execution, stop, interrupt, or recovery semantics

curobo.admission_behavior: A deployment selecting a cuRobo planning adapter is rejected because no implemented adapter capability manifest exists
